item.title: The Norwegian Bliss arrives this Thursday in Mazatlán with almost 6,000 people
item.description: For the second consecutive day, Mazatlán welcomed a cruise ship with nearly 6,000 passengers and crew members. item.title: Chayanne will give a concert in Mazatlán in May; it will generate an economic impact of 12 million pesos.
item.description: An attendance of 25,000 people and an economic impact of 12 million pesos are expected from Chayanne’s concert on May 2nd in Mazatlán. The Puerto Rican singer Chayanne will arrive in the port city with his 2026 tour. “Bailemos Otra Vez” (Let’s Dance Again), an international show, will take place at El Encanto Stadium. item.title: A New Criminal Map takes shape for Mexico
item.description: Mexico’s criminal landscape is undergoing a major shift following the death of Nemesio Oseguera Cervantes, alias El Mencho, leader of the Cartel Jalisco Nueva Generación (CJNG). item.description: A family denounced an act of discrimination on social media that occurred at a shopping mall in Mazatlán, where security personnel asked them to leave because their son, a child with autism, was barefoot.
